title: predict.vote
description: Phase 5.1: one predictor's contribution. Control-plane topic — unversioned by design (ROADMAP §3.7) because it is internal swarm traffic, never persisted, and never consumed across release boundaries. `distribution.market_outcomes` is a probability dict that sums to 1.0; `score_grid` is optional (only Dixon-Coles + the XGB pair populate it). Mirrors `ai/swarm/agents/payloads.py::PredictVote`.

distribution.description: {market_outcomes: dict[outcome -> prob], score_grid?: list[list[float]] | null}. When present, score_grid is a square 2D matrix where score_grid[home][away] = P(home goals = h, away goals = a); see ai/swarm/agents/predictors/_grid.py.

league_id.description: Round-tripped from PredictRequest so consensus + downstream ops can slice without joining by match_id.

profile_id.description: Round-tripped from PredictRequest; Phase 13a CalibrationProfile id.
